logp.method_description: About 100 μL of the labeled compound was added to 0.9 mL of water and 1 mL of octanol. The mixture was thoroughly mixed on a vortex mixer for about 3 min and then centrifuged at 3500 g for 5 min to effect clear separation of the two layers. About 0.8 mL of the octanol layer was withdrawn into another test tube and equal volume of fresh water was added. The mixture was vortexed again and then centrifuged as described above. Equal aliquot was withdrawn from n-octanol and aqueous layer and radioactivity associated with each layer was determined in a NaI(Tl) counter. The partition coefficient was calculated using the equation, LogPo/w = Log[(counts in n-octanol layer)/(counts in aqueous layer)].
